title: Cherat Cement explores rail options
body_markdown: **Pakistan:** Cherat Cement has expressed interest in using Pakistan Railways’ Peshawar Division to transport coal and cement. A delegation from the cement company, including Arshad and Wahid Islam Afridi, met with Divisional Superintendent Peshawar Imran Hayat to discuss joint freight operations, according to the News International newspaper. Cherat Cement raised the prospect of moving coal from Karachi Port to Cherat Cement’s plant and carrying cement onwards from the plant to target domestic markets.
